 Fabregas before US Sassuolo clash: We need to rely on the whole team
 Friday 23-10-2026 
 Sameh Salem 
 Cesc Fàbregas, the head coach of Como, has confirmed that his team needs to rely on all their players in the upcoming phase, given the ongoing injuries and the succession of matches, ahead of their clash against US Sassuolo tomorrow, as part of Serie A.
 Fabregas has clarified that Liberali is suffering from a minor injury and does not expect him to participate in the next match, while Kane will also be absent, with the possibility of returning on Tuesday to face Torino, although there are no guarantees regarding his readiness by then.
 The Spanish coach spoke about the importance of mentality and commitment within the team, praising the development of one of his players and his ability to contribute, while confirming that all players will get their chance. He also praised Ritchie, noting his admiration for his quality and mentality since joining the team, and that his opportunity will come soon, similar to Liberali, who has shown great commitment in training.
 Cesc Fàbregas has concluded his statements by confirming that there has been an improvement in Como's performance compared to recent matches, but he acknowledged that the team has suffered defensively to a greater extent compared to last season. He emphasized the need to achieve the required balance between the attacking and defensive sides, confirming that the team is on a path of development and gradual building.
